open_issues.impact: settings in a legacy .swissknifeman/config.toml of a marked project silently stop applying until moved to local/config.toml
open_issues.next: decide whether a later piece (or workspace project attach) copies the legacy config/state into local/; a read fallback to the legacy file would be a small change in project_config_file
open_issues.text: No migration: for a marked project whose workspace project folder exists, an existing <checkout>/.swissknifeman/config.toml and .swissknifeman/state/ (and backups/stubs) are no longer read; the project layer is local/config.toml. This repo's own tracked .swissknifeman/config.toml stops applying on a machine that has workspace axioma/projects/swissknifeman. I chose a deterministic rule (marker + folder exists) over a file-existence fallback.

open_issues.impact: repo.path in local/config.toml is still not written or read by anything; bindings.json stays the source of the checkout path
open_issues.next: the piece that retires bindings must decide what happens to extra checkouts (bindings has many paths per project, repo.path is one)
open_issues.text: bindings.json is still used: attach, bind, scan, rebind, detach, project_rows, doctor, integration.check_project, projects.remove and aicore source_root_of were not moved to localconfig.repo_path/set_repo_path. They are in packages/workspace (outside scope.include) and are writers, not readers; this piece moved the readers of the project folders only.

open_issues.impact: observer reports of a marked project still land in the checkout; the orch doctor reports-ignored check is unchanged
open_issues.next: move reports only together with the scope logic if the owner wants them in local/
open_issues.text: Orch REPORTS (.swissknifeman/orch/reports) and orch-artifacts (.swissknifeman/orch-artifacts) stay in the checkout; the conductor's git-scope logic (scopes.own/dirty) uses these checkout-relative paths. Only conductor/journal state (project_state_dir) moved to local/.

open_issues.next: use project_local_dir / project_stubs_dir instead of building .swissknifeman paths
open_issues.text: Lookup rule for later pieces: project_local_dir needs only workspace + project_id from the marker (so a launcher-only marker works) and returns None while <workspaces>/<ws>/projects/<code> does not exist (e.g. a fresh clone before workspace clone); local/ itself need not exist, writers must use localconfig.ensure_local. P3.4/P3.5 can read repo path and local dir through aicore.workspace.localconfig or aicore.state.project_local_dir; SKM_WORKSPACES_ROOT is honoured, SKM_WORKSPACE is not (the marker names the workspace).

open_issues.impact: a project with a local/ folder cannot be removed
open_issues.text: projects.remove still treats local/ as held (PROJECT_NOT_EMPTY): not touched, since packages/workspace is outside scope.include and the question of whether local/ counts as held is open from P3.1.

open_issues.impact: V1 may be red on subprocess tests while the frozen aicore copy is stale
open_issues.text: AICORE_ROOT in the conductor environment points to a frozen copy taken before the P3.1/P3.2 changes. Tests that run a subprocess against it (workspace test_the_launcher_runs_the_module; any subprocess importing project_stubs_dir/project_local_dir) can fail under V1 for that reason only. All my runs used AICORE_ROOT=packages/aicore.

open_issues.impact: V1 may fail in analyst independent of this piece
open_issues.next: report to the owner / fix in analyst separately
open_issues.text: packages/analyst tests.test_scan has 3 failures (pattern ids 'axioma-cross-project-shared-lesson-...' in the listing). They fail the same on a clean worktree of HEAD, so they are pre-existing and unrelated; V1 may be red on them.

open_issues.impact: planner test changed to the new contract
open_issues.text: The existing planner test test_new_plan_takes_the_configuration_and_the_name_of_the_bound_checkout wrote the project layer into the checkout's .swissknifeman/config.toml of a workspace-bound project; with the new rule that file is not read, so the test now writes local/config.toml of the workspace project (and a new test pins that the checkout file is ignored).

summary: aicore.state project_config_file/project_state_dir/project_backups_dir (new env=/home= args) and the new project_stubs_dir/project_local_dir now resolve through the marker .swissknifeman/project.json to <workspace>/projects/<code>/local/{config.toml,state,backups,stubs} when that workspace project folder exists on the machine; otherwise (no marker, unusable marker, folder missing) they keep .swissknifeman/ as before. The config project layer, config CLI (set/paths), backups (local files under <stamp>/local/...), blobs, journal, stubs, project context 'config' and project doctor (config + write-boundary of local/state and local/backups) follow; planner settings, orch conductor state and the other callers follow through the same functions. Orch doctor reports a runtime folder outside the checkout as ok. Tests, docs and the aicore changelog updated. Unit tests run instead of V1 (not run, the conductor runs it): aicore full unittest discover (1765 OK), workspace (328 OK), planner test_settings (35 OK), planner test_launcher_mode/test_workspace/test_commit/test_commits_read/test_refs (115 OK), orch test_conductor_contracts (22 OK), skiller test_provider_config, harness test_run_plan_reader; scripts/ecosystem-units.py check exits 0.
